name: v2.2.0
body:
## What's Changed

This is a small release consisting of several small bugfixes.

Enjoy!

## Changelog

### Bugfix

* Make sure to properly initialize Arrow Compute by @robomics in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/449
* Force override revisions of build_requirements in conanfile by @robomics in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/452
* Fix path/URI accessors for default-constructed cooler::File objects by @robomics in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/451
* Fix runtime error when pre-allocating sparse martrices by @robomics in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/453
* Include spdlog's version in telemetry data by @robomics in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/455
* Fix build when -DHICTK_ASSUME_STD_FILESYSTEM_AVAIL=ON by @robomics in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/460
* Make HiCFileWriter movable by @robomics in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/463
* Respect resolution and unit when querying .hic files for available normalizations by @robomics in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/466

### Testing

* Properly handle ContentTooShortError in test/fuzzer/scripts/download_test_datasets.py by @robomics in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/465
* Fix integration tests by @robomics in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/464

### Dependencies

* Bump dependencies by @robomics in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/469, and https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/474

### CI

* Update macOS CI by @robomics in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/447
* Build the Dockerfile using Clang 21 by @robomics in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/454
* Refactor CI by @robomics in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/456
* Fix CodeQL (C++) by @robomics in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/458
* Increase timeout for unit tests in ubuntu-ci.yml by @robomics in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/459
* pre-commit autoupdate by @pre-commit-ci[bot] in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/450
* Address cache thrashing by @robomics in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/468
* Disable TRAP caching in codeql-cpp.yml by @robomics in https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/pull/467


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk/compare/v2.1.5...v2.2.0
